purpose: Known-development-body comparison of per-motor and shared paired light probes
exposure: The two published v3 training worlds and all three successor bodies are development data. No validation or held-out worlds are instantiated.
comparison_budget: Equal 40-second total episode budget, including each strategy's probing time
hypotheses: Paired individual motor probes can expose different local light-response signs after a transmission reversal.
A disconnected shaft may produce little or contradictory light-response evidence, which does not by itself identify disconnection.
Individual probing may improve useful control compared with broadcasting one shared direction; results on this small family may also refute that benefit.
measurements: privileged final pose for reporting only
acceptance: Engineering checks require causal observations, real mechanics, ownership isolation, reset/replay determinism and fail-closed safety. No performance or generalization acceptance decision is defined for these exposed development runs.
future_challenge: A fresh separately versioned challenge family must be designated and kept outside development before any future generalization claim. This experiment declares no unseen challenge or official held-out result.
